description:
Summary:

Annotate the pure value-returning helpers in StringUtil.h: str, Join, isPrint, SourceLocation::current, the tryToNumber<int64_t>/<double> specializations, and split. Each computes and returns a value with no side effect; discarding it is a bug.

ReplaceAll is left unannotated: it mutates its string argument in place and returning the replacement count is secondary, so discarding the count is a valid use.

Mirrored across the fbcode and xplat copies of the header.

Test Plan: [[nodiscard]] is enforced at compile time via -Werror; relies on CI to surface external discarding call sites. Local `arc lint` is clean.
title: c10 StringUtil: add [[nodiscard]] to value-returning helpers (#189928)
